conflict_rules: Engineering Design Contracts govern implementation details not uniquely measurable from a Frozen PNG; they do not authorize changing the Frozen page hierarchy.
Frozen state PNG owns Hero container placement; Hero Media Contract owns dynamic user-photo placement inside that container.
State-specific Frozen PNG wins over the Core Visual reference for state differences.
Result spec wins over runtime behavior when runtime is implementation debt.
Global Recognition Runtime Contract wins for classifier/detector/confidence semantics.
Missing runtime capability must be recorded as a gap; it must not silently rewrite design intent.
Species Selector V1 owns only the selector; it cannot change the 05–09 Frozen Result pages or their hierarchy.
